overview: Research draft record, unpublished: every statement below is an unverified lead, not a verified fact. Described in search results as a multi-faculty university (state) in Kherson (legal seat lead: Admission Committee address 'Universitets'ka 27, Kherson' on a kspu.edu page). Reported relocated to Ivano-Frankivsk since 2022, working on the premises of Vasyl Stefanyk Precarpathian National University (kspu.edu Medicine department history page and fundraising page, undated in results; osvita.ua/consultations/86867, undated). The International Relations Office address shown on kspu.edu is in Ivano-Frankivsk., Ukraine, with leads for medicine, nursing programmes. Draft record built from search-result leads on 2026-10-24; no official page was opened (official hosts are refused by this environment's network policy). The institution is reported as relocated; its current base is unconfirmed. No fee, deadline or intake date is recorded. Every field is awaiting verification against the official pages listed under research references, and nothing here is presented as a current fact.

openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Location lead as found (unverified): Kherson (legal seat lead: Admission Committee address 'Universitets'ka 27, Kherson' on a kspu.edu page). Reported relocated to Ivano-Frankivsk since 2022, working on the premises of Vasyl Stefanyk Precarpathian National University (kspu.edu Medicine department history page and fundraising page, undated in results; osvita.ua/consultations/86867, undated). The International Relations Office address shown on kspu.edu is in Ivano-Frankivsk.

Relocation lead (unverified): Search-result leads (no official page read): the Medical Faculty's own history page says that 'after the start of the full-scale invasion in 2022, the faculty, together with the university, was moved to Ivano-Frankivsk' using the premises of Vasyl Stefanyk Precarpathian National University (https://www.kspu.edu/About/Faculty/Medicine/DepartmentOfMedicine/111.aspx?lang=en, undated). The fundraising page describes 'its temporary relocation to Ivano-Frankivsk, to the premises of Vasyl Stefanyk Precarpathian National University, in 2022' and says the Kherson buildings, assembly hall, observatory and 'all dormitories have been damaged' (https://www.kspu.edu/About/DepartmentAndServices/Fundraising.aspx?lang=en, undated). osvita.ua reports the university 'перемістився до Івано-Франківська, проводить набір студентів і видає українські дипломи' and warns not to confuse it with 'самопроголошеною структурою у захопленому окупантами Херсоні' (https://osvita.ua/consultations/86867/, undated in results, occupation-era wording). A KSU repository item is titled 'хроніки релокованого вишу' (https://ekhsuir.kspu.edu/items/57057904-cec1-46db-bbea-554f3265ea73, undated). The kspu.edu International Relations Office address is shown in Ivano-Frankivsk while the Admission Committee address is still 'Universitets'ka 27, Kherson'. The 2025 vstup.osvita.ua listing sits under region code r10 (vs r22 in 2017-2020), consistent with the move. Date of the relocation reports: 2022 (event year as stated by the pages); report dates not shown.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No 2025 admission offer for 222 Medicine found on vstup.osvita.ua; the only 2025 card tagged 'Медичний факультет' is a Chemistry master's. The inventory records the faculty page title as 'Medical Faculty (Archive)' and education.ua shows a renamed 'Факультет медицини, здоров'я та спорту' - the medicine programme may be discontinued, suspended or restructured. Do not list a medicine programme until an official 2026 admission page or EDEBO/NAQA record is read.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No lead of English-medium medical teaching or of foreign-applicant intake for medicine. The only English-medium lead is Economics (bachelor/master, 'IELTS 5.5+', on the FBP International Student page); the Medical Faculty 'Концепція викладання та використання англійської мови 2023-2027' is a policy document, not a programme.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Relocated institution: legal seat in Kherson (front-line city; campus buildings and all dormitories reported damaged), operating from another university's premises in Ivano-Frankivsk. Address data on official pages is mixed (Kherson for admissions, Ivano-Frankivsk for the international office).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Identity confusion: osvita.ua warns about a 'self-proclaimed structure' in occupied Kherson using the university's identity (occupation-era report). Any site or contact claiming to be 'Kherson State University' in Kherson under occupation administration must be rejected.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion with other Kherson institutions that appeared in the same searches: Kherson State Maritime Academy (ksma.ks.ua), Kherson National Technical University (kntu.net.ua), Kherson State Agrarian and Economic University (ksau.kherson.ua), and the Kherson Basic Medical Professional College (inventory slug kherson-basic-medical-college). None of these is KSU.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Two or three hosts in play: kspu.edu / www.kspu.edu / old.kspu.edu (legacy 'pedagogical university' domain), an admissions e-mail on ksu.kherson.ua, and a search-engine suggestion of 'ksu.ks.ua' that is unverified and must not be used.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The Henichesk Professional College of KSU offers vocational nursing and medical-massage programmes (фаховий молодший бакалавр). These are college-level, not university degrees, and must not be presented as KSU medicine/nursing degrees; Henichesk lies in the occupied part of Kherson oblast (general knowledge; the college's relocation status was not found in these searches).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: A TSN report of a university in Kherson 'hit' by FPV drones quotes a 'Kherson branch head' ('We had about three thousand students'); the article did not show which university was meant, so it is not attributed to KSU here.

Missing evidence: Whether KSU currently runs (and admits to) a 222 Medicine master's programme at all: no 2025 admission offer, licence volume or NAQA accreditation record found; the faculty page is archived/renamed. Needs the official 2026 Rules of Admission (Правила прийому) or the vstup.osvita.ua y2025/y2026 r10/48 listing for field 22 'Охорона здоров'я', read in full.
Missing evidence: EDEBO registry entry (licence for 222 Medicine, 226 Pharmacy, 221 Dentistry, 223 Nursing, or the new I-series health codes) and NAQA accreditation certificates: not found.

Missing evidence: Whether any medicine/health programme at KSU is open to foreign applicants, and whether any is taught in English: no lead found (only Economics shows English-medium teaching and IELTS requirement).

Missing evidence: Confirmation of the official domain: kspu.edu is the consistent lead, but the admissions e-mail is on ksu.kherson.ua and the suggested 'ksu.ks.ua' is unverified; no official page could be opened.
Missing evidence: Official English and Ukrainian legal names (statute/EDEBO form) and ownership (state) confirmed from an official register rather than directory listings.
Missing evidence: Current operating base and address for applicants (Ivano-Frankivsk premises vs Kherson legal address), and the date of the most recent official statement on relocation.
Missing evidence: Whether the 'Study in Ukraine' portal entry id 163 belongs to KSU, and what it lists.
Missing evidence: Status and location of the Henichesk Professional College (occupied-territory risk) and whether it is still an operating KSU subdivision.
Missing evidence: Any fee, duration or quota figures for health programmes: none found; nothing should be published.

Skeptic's note: Medicine (222) must NOT be presented as a current programme: no 2025 or 2026 admission card for Medicine was found, the faculty appears renamed 'Факультет медицини, здоров'я та спорту' and the old faculty page is titled 'Medical Faculty (Archive)'. The qualifying degree lead is a 2026 Pharmacy master's card, seen only in search summaries of an EDEBO-fed aggregator (page not opened).
